resources.name: MiniSearch
resources.usage: Client-side Library and chapter-list metadata search over allow-listed metadata.
resources.fallback: Local substring search over the same metadata allow-list.
resources.rollback: Remove the vendor script tag and MiniSearch adapter calls; retain substring filtering.
resources.notes: Vendored in v11.4. The recorded checksum is the normalized LF artifact checksum; Windows checkouts may have CRLF bytes.

resources.name: Readium Web Publication Manifest
resources.usage: Reference model for metadata, readingOrder, resources, links, and TOC.
resources.fallback: Continue current GodTranslator novel/chapter API model.
resources.rollback: Remove adapter layer and keep direct API responses.
resources.notes: Use through an adapter before any schema change.

resources.name: Readium CSS
resources.usage: Reference and prototype source for reading typography, user settings, CJK, RTL, and vertical-writing handling.
resources.fallback: Keep current GodTranslator Reader CSS variables.
resources.rollback: Remove any Readium-inspired variables or prototype stylesheet before production adoption.
resources.notes: Adopt parts only; do not replace GodTranslator navigation or product identity.

resources.name: foliate-js
resources.usage: Isolated benchmark candidate for EPUB, CFI, pagination, book search, annotations, and traversal.
resources.fallback: Current escaped paragraph renderer and future Readium-style adapter.
resources.notes: Do not import the GPL Foliate application. Only evaluate the MIT foliate-js package.

resources.name: Komga
resources.usage: Reference for library UX, OPDS, collections, progress, sync concepts, and account-scoped reading.
resources.fallback: Keep GodTranslator Library and Reader flows.
resources.notes: Do not migrate to Komga's stack.

resources.name: Kavita
resources.usage: Product benchmark for EPUB reader settings, annotations, fonts, themes, mobile reader behavior, and progress.
resources.fallback: Keep current Reader UX roadmap.
resources.notes: Reference behavior only unless license compatibility is explicitly approved.

resources.name: BookLore
resources.usage: Reference for multi-user library UX, shelves, metadata, full-text search, OPDS, reader notebook, highlights, notes, and progress.
resources.fallback: GodTranslator-native Library, notes, and search models.
resources.notes: AGPL source is reference-only without explicit compatibility review.

resources.name: Calibre-Web
resources.usage: Reference for Python web ebook server architecture, OPDS, permissions, shelves, metadata, reader support, uploads, and administration.
resources.fallback: GodTranslator FastAPI/Postgres architecture.
resources.notes: GPL source is reference-only unless separately approved.

resources.name: epub.js
resources.usage: Compare with foliate-js and Readium for EPUB rendering, CFI, locations, annotations, search, and pagination.
resources.fallback: Use foliate-js or Readium-style adapter prototypes first.
resources.notes: Maintenance signals require caution before production adoption.

resources.name: EPUBCheck
resources.usage: Future dev/CI validation for EPUB import/export conformance.
resources.fallback: Manual EPUB export inspection until EPUB export exists.
resources.notes: Do not claim EPUB conformance without validation.

resources.name: OPDS 2.0
resources.usage: Future authenticated library catalog for compatible readers/devices.
resources.fallback: GodTranslator web Library only.
resources.rollback: Disable OPDS routes if introduced later.
resources.notes: Requires authorization, privacy, and rate-limit design before implementation.

resources.name: Readium Locators and EPUB CFI
resources.usage: Design target for resilient progress and bookmark positions across layout changes.
resources.fallback: Current chapter plus scroll percentage model.
resources.rollback: Keep legacy progress fields as authoritative until migration is proven.
resources.notes: Use a hybrid locator before any production progress migration.

resources.name: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
resources.usage: Future highlight, note, and bookmark model using robust selectors.
resources.fallback: Current bookmark-only model.
resources.rollback: Keep Web Annotation data in additive tables until stable.
resources.notes: Design first; do not migrate bookmarks in v11.5.

resources.name: Workbox
resources.usage: Future app-shell and asset caching, routing, range requests, and offline recipes.
resources.fallback: Online-only web app.
resources.rollback: Unregister service worker and clear Workbox caches.
resources.notes: Needs privacy review before caching authorized chapters.

resources.name: Dexie
resources.usage: Future structured IndexedDB storage for offline chapters, progress, and sync queue.
resources.fallback: Server-backed progress and localStorage preferences.
resources.rollback: Clear IndexedDB object stores and disable offline mode.
resources.notes: Choose Dexie or idb after a dedicated offline prototype.

resources.name: idb
resources.usage: Alternative lightweight IndexedDB wrapper for offline chapters and sync metadata.
resources.fallback: Dexie or raw IndexedDB.
resources.notes: Lower abstraction than Dexie, easier rollback.

resources.name: DOMPurify
resources.usage: Future sanitization boundary for imported EPUB HTML or other untrusted markup.
resources.fallback: Keep current escaped plain-text rendering.
resources.notes: Current Reader text should remain escaped text. Pin a version patched past known 2026 advisories if adopted.

resources.name: axe-core
resources.usage: Automated serious/critical accessibility checks for Reader, Library, Settings, Admin, and Translator Workspace.
resources.fallback: Manual accessibility review plus existing Playwright checks.
resources.notes: Automated scans complement but do not replace keyboard and screen-reader review.

resources.name: TanStack Virtual
resources.usage: Benchmark for very large chapter/history/result lists if native pagination becomes insufficient.
resources.fallback: Server-side pagination and current 50-row page model.
resources.notes: Headless virtual-core can fit a no-framework frontend if needed.

resources.name: Thorium Reader
resources.usage: Reference for Readium Desktop, EPUB/WebPub navigation, bookmarks, tags, and accessibility-oriented reader behavior.
resources.fallback: GodTranslator web Reader.
resources.notes: Desktop app architecture is not a direct fit, but Readium usage is valuable.

resources.name: KOReader
resources.usage: Reference for e-ink/device reading, OPDS workflows, dictionaries, reading settings, and sync concepts.
resources.fallback: GodTranslator web/mobile Reader.
resources.notes: AGPL source is reference-only.

resources.name: Vivliostyle
resources.usage: Reference for CSS paged-media rendering and EPUB/PDF publication workflows.
resources.fallback: Browser scroll reader plus future Foliate/Readium prototypes.
resources.notes: Strong copyleft makes direct code adoption inappropriate for this branch.

resources.name: Uppy
resources.usage: Future richer browser upload UX for packs, EPUBs, source files, retries, and resumable imports.
resources.fallback: Current native browser upload controls and import preview.
resources.rollback: Remove upload adapter and restore native controls.
resources.notes: Supporting tool only; should not drive Reader architecture.
